jina: Authority to constitute offices and to appoint persons to hold offices
maudhui: (1) Subject to the other provisions of this Constitution and of any other law, the President shall have authority to constitute and to abolish offices of various descriptions in the service of the Government of the United Republic. (2) The President shall have power to appoint persons to hold offices of leaders responsible for formulating policies of departments and institutions of the Government, and the chief executives responsible for supervising the implementation of those policies. (3) Subject to the provisions of subarticle (2), the authority to appoint all other persons who are not leaders or chief executives to hold offices in the service of the Government of the United Republic shall vest in the Service Commissions. (4) The provisions of subarticles (2) and (3) shall not be construed as preventing the President from taking steps to maintain discipline among public servants and in the public service of the Government of the United Republic.
